organization.name: The Asc3nd Collective
organization.tagline: Empower youth. Elevate futures. Build community.
organization.mission_statement: Asc3nd exists to equip young people with the confidence, support, and opportunities they need to keep moving forward.

event.name: Community Cuts for Kids
event.description: Fresh Fade, Fresh Grade is a free back-to-school community event designed to help students start the school year with confidence. Through free haircuts, school supplies, and community support, we're bringing families together to ensure every child feels prepared, empowered, and ready to succeed.

programs.name: Mentorship
programs.description: Trusted mentors who encourage, guide, and help young people discover their potential.

programs.name: Leadership
programs.description: Programs that develop confidence, character, responsibility, and purpose through real-world experiences.

programs.name: Life Skills & Athletics
programs.description: Hands-on experiences that build life skills, healthy habits, teamwork, and resilience.

programs.name: Community Connection
programs.description: Bringing together families, mentors, schools, businesses, churches, and neighbors to create a community where every young person can succeed.

founder_story: The Asc3nd Collective was founded by Otha and Elisha Minnifield on a simple belief: one caring mentor, one meaningful opportunity, and one supportive community can change the trajectory of a young person's life.

voice.tone: Warm, direct, community-oriented, confident without arrogance
